title: board-files test times out on the Windows CI job
notes: PR #421's windows job (a PR not touching board files) failed src/main/board/board-files.test.ts 'names a board.json that does not parse on a read without salvage' at 6.4 s, over vitest's 5 s limit, same pattern as finished-work.test.ts (d976a3c6, #404): likely git or process spawns that are slow on the Windows runner. Find what the test spends its time on from the run log and make it fast; raise the timeout only for that test if that is the honest fix, saying why.
